question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A judgement or verdict that a person is not guilty of the crime with which he has been charged
solution:
The correct answer is: **Acquittal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Acquittal"** means a judgement or verdict that a person is not guilty of the crime with which he has been charged. (निर्दोषता)

 
 
• **Example: **After a long trial, the court announced the **acquittal **of the accused due to lack of evidence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Petition **(याचिका): A formal written request appealing to authority with respect to a particular cause.

 
 
• **Example:** The citizens filed a **petition **to save the local park from being demolished.
 
 
 
• **Appellant **(अपीलकर्ता): A person who applies to a higher court for a reversal of the decision of a lower court.
 
 
• **Example: **The **appellant **argued that the trial court had made a legal error.
 
 
 
• **Writ** (परवाना): A form of written command in the name of a court or other legal authority.
 
 
• **Example:** The court issued a **writ **of habeas corpus to ensure the individual's release from unlawful detention.
